source_text: In the 2000s and 2010s, numerous reports of fatalities and severe complications during ulwaluko rites in South Africa's Eastern Cape province generated widespread public concern, with media accounts citing dozens of deaths per initiation season, often exceeding 70 annually in the region. [41]
